thread:
maria: Heads up — since ~03:15 UTC we're seeing bidi transcribe streams stall in eu-west-1. Client stays connected but no tokens emitted after ~65s. Repro on hosted + dedicated routes. :warning:

dmitri: Which path? ALB -> envoy edge -> ml-proxy? Any LB logs?

maria: ALB fronting -> envoy edge-proxy -> ml-serving pool. Excerpted logs below.

maria: ```envoy[2026-02-25T03:15:17Z] [warning] stream stalled: last_write_age=65s, rcv_window=0, RST_STREAM received
ALB access: target_status=504 elb_status=200 request_processing_time=0.01 target_processing_time=65.012
kernel: nf_conntrack: table full? conntrack: timeout on tcp flow id 0x7f
```

ashley: Can you paste ss/lsof around the time? This smells like conntrack expiry + SNAT port reuse sending return packets to the wrong backend.

maria: ```# ss -tanp | grep 443
ESTAB 0 0 10.1.2.3:443 10.2.3.45:52344 users:(("envoy",pid=1234,fd=45))
TIME-WAIT 0 0 10.1.2.3:443 10.2.3.46:52345
```

samir: We've seen NAT port reuse bite us when backend keeps idle longer than conntrack timeout. What's Cloud NAT conntrack timeout in eu-west-1?

tzeng: Cloud NAT/SNAT default tcp timeout = 120s in that region; host conntrack on some node images is 60s. If host conntrack drops the mapping, the NAT can reuse the ephemeral port and replies go elsewhere.

dmitri: Also consider Envoy HTTP/2 flow-control: if the remote window hits 0 and envoy queues large writes, it sometimes stops propagating WINDOW_UPDATE upstream (seen in an older envoy). Combined with conntrack churn, this looks like a hard stall.

maria: Repro steps: open bidi stream, stream audio continuously; tokens stop at ~65s almost consistently. Restarting envoy on node makes the stream continue (same client reconnects and proceeds) — points to in-proxy state.

ashley: Quick mitigations to try in prod canary: enable gRPC keepalive pings, bump ALB idle timeout, and disable proxy buffering on the route. Proposed patch snippet: 

ashley: ```nginx:
  proxy_http_version: "1.1"
  proxy_buffering: "off"
envoy:
  upstream_http2_options: {enable_connection_age: false}
GRPC keepalive: keepalive_time=30 keepalive_timeout=10
ALB idle_timeout: 300
```

samir: +1 to keepalive. I'll run a staging POC that sends HTTP/2 PINGs and monitors WINDOW_UPDATE and stream write queues.

deploy-bot: rollout started: infra/edge-proxy hotfix -> canary 10% (sha:abc123). Watching: #monitoring-alerts.

maria: Canary looks better after keepalive + buffering off: no stalls in 2h window. Planning 100% after +4h if stable.

dmitri: Please also open a ticket with the cloud team to check NAT conntrack sizing and ephemeral port pool in eu-west-1 (we should request a bigger ephemeral range). Link to follow-up issue: https://internal/issue/INF-8342

tzeng: Long-term: add a perf test for sustained 5m bidi streams and track window-update counters + conntrack churn. Add alert if stalled_streams > 0.1%.

maria: I'll update the runbook with the debugging checklist (ss, conntrack -L, envoy /stats, ALB access logs) and correlate with stream metrics. :thumbsup:

samir: Creating incident page and action items now.
